YOUR DATA. YOUR CONTROL.

Privacy, in plain sight.

How Clipora handles clipboard data, local storage and optional connections.

CLIPORA RESOURCES

This privacy policy explains the information accessed, stored and transmitted by Clipora Clipboard, published by Clipora. Clipboard data stays on your computer unless you enable optional sync or export a backup. It is used to provide clipboard history, search, organization, automation and paste functionality.

Effective 7 October 2026 · Publisher: Clipora

Clipboard access

Clipora records supported content you copy while the app runs and recording is enabled. This may include text, links, images, rich text, HTML and file paths. It does not import another app’s clipboard history.

Pause recording or exclude applications in Capture settings when copying sensitive information. Not every application marks sensitive fields as private.

Local storage and encryption

History, saved formats, images and descriptive metadata are encrypted locally. Windows DPAPI protects account-bound keys, and clip payloads use AES-256-GCM. Timestamps, pin/order information and database structure remain visible.

Deletion is not a secure disk wipe. Keep the database and its key together, or use a password-encrypted backup when transferring your library.

Network and optional features

Clipora implements no advertising, analytics or AI uploads. Sync is off by default. If you explicitly enable sync, encrypted snapshots and device identifiers go to the folder or private server you choose. Those providers have their own storage and access policies.

Macro downloads contact the URL you enter. Opening a link uses your default browser and its privacy rules. File clips store references, not file contents.

Trusted macros

Imported macros start untrusted. A macro you explicitly trust executes full .NET code with your Windows user permissions and can access files or the network. Review its code before trusting it. The worker timeout is not a security sandbox.

Retention, deletion and backups

You can pause recording, exclude applications, set retention, delete clips after confirmation, clear unpinned history, export encrypted backups or disable sync. Pinned clips survive automatic retention. Stored backups and external sync copies require separate deletion.

The app records only while running. Closing the workspace leaves it in the tray; choosing Quit Clipora stops it. This privacy notice is also available offline in Settings → General → Privacy & data controls.

Update checks

Clipora can check for published updates automatically, at startup and at most once per day while running. Disable automatic checks in Settings → General. Store installations query Microsoft Store. Standalone installations query public release metadata on clipora.deltabits.in; the server receives ordinary connection metadata. Clipboard content, history and encryption keys are not included in these requests. Installing a Store update requires your action.

This website

This website has no analytics scripts, advertising or forms collecting personal information. Its interactive playground uses synthetic samples in browser memory and never reads or writes your device clipboard. Fonts are self-hosted. The demo is reset on page reload. The hosting service may process ordinary connection information needed to serve the page, such as IP address and request metadata.

Contact the publisher

For support or privacy questions, contact Clipora through the Clipora support and privacy issue tracker. Reports are public and require a GitHub account. Do not submit clipboard content, private file paths, encryption keys, passwords or tokens. GitHub handles account and report data under its own privacy policy. Clipora does not provide email support at this time.

Windows app storage

The Microsoft Store version uses Windows-managed package storage that is not automatically backed up to the cloud by Clipora. Updates retain that storage; uninstalling or resetting the Store app may remove it. Export an encrypted backup before uninstalling or resetting. The standalone desktop library is stored separately and is not deleted by installing the Store app. Use an encrypted backup to transfer it to the Store version.

Policy changes

This page will be updated when the app's data practices change. The effective date identifies the current policy.

Browser text tools and demonstration

The website demonstration uses synthetic examples and never reads your device clipboard. The plain-text and line-break tools process text only in the browser tab’s memory. Input, results and undo state are not saved to browser storage, sent to Clipora or added to URLs. Leaving or reloading the page clears that in-memory state.

The text tools write the result to your clipboard only when you press Copy result. The mobile download-link button copies only the public Store URL when pressed. Clipboard access can be denied by your browser; manual selection and copying remain available. These features do not enable background clipboard reading.

No text analytics, session replay or input logging is added. Normal hosting requests are still processed as described above.
